mentions.name: MockHack
mentions.description: This service runs sandboxed 'obliterated' (uncensored) LLMs such as DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-Obliterated and OrcaCyber-Zero that attempt to hack a site, letting site owners test their own defenses against bot-driven hacking attacks. Anyone can try it at mockhack.com.
mentions.problem: Sites get constantly hit by bots trying to hack them, so owners need a way to hack their own sites to test their defenses.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm getting hit constantly by bots trying to hack my site, so I'm trying to hack my own sites. Pretty much I have a few obliterated LLMs (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-Obliterated, OrcaCyber-Zero, etc) which run on their own sandbox to try to hack me.

If anyone wants to try it, you can test it on mockhack.com
mentions.author: timm37
